Name: Growable Moss Extended - English Translation
Author: Arillume
Description:
This is an English translation of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25929]Growable Moss Extend[/url] by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Skeleton0w0/about-me?gameId=1303]﻿Skeleton0w0

[/url]Adds a new crop: Moss Stump,
can be planted in any season on tilled soil, harvested via scythe and will continue to grow after being harvested﻿﻿. The moss will not have any quality.

Adds new recipes for the dehydrator:﻿
Put in 20 moss to produce 10 fiber,
Put in 10 fiber to produce 10 hay.

Adds a new cooking recipe: Moss Pie,
This recipe can be purchased from the Dwarf in the mine.
